article.headline: VMI secures 89-36 victory against Christendom
article.description: — TJ Johnson scored 22 points as VMI beat Christendom 89-36 on Friday.
article.story: LEXINGTON, Va. -- — TJ Johnson scored 22 points as VMI beat Christendom 89-36 on Friday. Johnson also had 11 rebounds for the Keydets (4-7). Walker Andrews scored 17 points while shooting 6 for 13, including 5 for 9 from beyond the arc. Jaylen Pazon had 13 points and shot 5 for 12. The Keydets stopped a six-game skid with the victory. Bobby Vander Woude finished with 13 points for the Crusaders. Luke Ross added seven points for Christendom. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
